question: Does Block0 residual/group-direction radial alignment require the correct token pairing, or survive as shared position-common/anisotropic geometry?
motivation: Follow the row-permutation and common-mode alternative in the separately authored 0bd9bbc E0 discovery; this is an empirical discriminator, not an independent endorsement.
direction: Decode the same five complete post-Q2 64-channel W2 panels in FP64 and apply the actual channel gate. This is not a BF16 finite deletion.
primary_control: Exact expectation over within-scope, within-group row derangements. Evaluate all ordered off-diagonal row pairs; no random permutations or p-values.
secondary_controls: Exact within-stratum derangement expectation for three fixed latent-time bands [0,7), [7,14), [14,21); singleton strata retain their own row and coverage is reported.
Exact within-stratum derangement expectation for four fixed spatial quadrants using y>=15 and x>=26 on the [21,29,52] FFN token grid; singleton strata retain their own row.
Equal-row squared cosine after channel centering removes direction-magnitude weighting.
A position-common residual direction, computed from the same saved 32 rows, tests common-state direction alone. This is a posthoc descriptive reference, not a deployed predictor.
metrics: Radial energy removed by the ideal epsilon-LN tangent, with original summed direction-energy denominator; mean equal-row cosine squared; paired-minus-deranged excess; fraction of centered-channel operand energy in the position mean. For position-demeaned operands use their own energy denominator and do not call this the original LayerNorm response.
verification: Reproduce all 1440 original radial energy fractions within numerical tolerance; analytic controls for exact derangement expectation and position-common versus token-specific examples.
aggregation: Report equal-case block means and each of the six sources, with step/expert splits. Rows, groups and layers are repeated measurements, not independent sources.
scope: Saved-operand CPU analysis only, no model import, native FFN/norm, generation, GPU, training, new weights or candidate selection. No automatic followup and no change to E0 stage or model authority.
